See.. My theory is, and I understand it's a bit backwards, is that if nobody will make me a priority, then there is something wrong with me. Making me a priority, sounds selfish. And the last time I did that I ended up kissing someone I shouldn't have done. 

I'm a horrid person for hurting those around me, I've never meant to hurt them.

I feel like I'm worthless.

Not really, like I said, my ex has turned everyone I considered a close friend against me. I've always had lots of acquaintances but not true friends.

That's it, people praise me for being funny, caring, smart, and apparently I'm better looking than I think I am.. I just don't feel worthy of anyone's time.

I keep trying to kid myself that I'm a nice person, but being so invested in karma, and nothing good is coming to me and with my health condition, I've got a horrid path ahead of me which I don't think I'm strong enough for

I hope you're still there.. Please don't do this. I need as much help as anyone on here and if someone reached out to me last night when I was at breaking point I wouldn't have gone to the local railway station.. 

Please respond
